item.title: Nativo Resources publishes benchmark study for proposed Peru gold plant
item.summary: Nativo Resources has published research setting out the business case for its proposed La Patona gold processing plant in Peru, benchmarking the project against established operators in the country’s artisanal and small-scale mining sector.
